This '''unidentified [[Planet/Legends|planet]]''' was the location of a downed Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the ''[[Anya Karu]]''. [[Aron Harcourt]], the captain of the ship, once sent the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] to the planet to retrieve a [[Hologram/Legends|holo]]-recording of Harcourt's wife, [[Janelle Harcourt|Janelle]], from the wreckage.

Upon his arrival, Fett's ship, the [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']], engaged several patrolling [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] in battle. After he landed, Fett explored the downed ''Anya Karu'' and was attacked by [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]] who had taken refuge within the wreckage. He barely escaped the wreck when it was destroyed by the [[Liberator (Imperial I-class)|''Adjudicator'']].
